dna.essence_text: A chilling anthology series that masterfully explores the dark implications of advanced technology on human society and psychology. titles.title: Black Mirror

titles.title: Preacher

Its intricate plot and morally ambiguous themes make it a compelling, albeit heavy, viewing experience.

titles.overview: When a 13-year-old is accused of the murder of a classmate, his family, therapist and the detective in charge are all left asking: what really happened?
